    Nova Peptides is a research-use peptide shop. We have tracked it since 23 Oct 2026 and last checked it on 8 Nov 2026.

    It lists 37 products across 27 substances. The most listed: BPC-157 (4 listings), TB-500 (thymosin beta-4 fragment 17-23) (4 listings) and GHK-Cu (3 listings). Price per mg: $0.054 to $149.98. These are research-use peptides: vials labelled for lab use, not approved for use in people. Bremelanotide is in FDA-approved medicines, but a research-use vial is not that medicine.

    We found a lab report for 10 of the 12 substances in the table above. The newest is dated 30 Sep 2026. A lab report tests one batch; it says nothing about a vial from another batch, and we do not test products ourselves.

    We found no FDA warning letter to Nova Peptides in the letters the FDA publishes, as of 8 Nov 2026.

    We could not match Nova Peptides to a company in a state business registry. We show a company only from a registry or an FDA letter, never from the seller's own pages.

    Its site did not let us read its terms, privacy and refund pages on 4 Nov 2026.

    These are the facts we hold; we do not call any seller legit or safe, and we never link to the shop.
